name: moodle-mcp
description: Moodle MCP server for students. A Model Context Protocol MCP server that gives AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor read only access to Moodle courses: assignments, due dates, grades, announcements and course content.

tools.name: get_my_courses
tools.description: Lists your current courses with the ID other tools take as course_id. Hides finished and hidden courses.

tools.name: get_upcoming_due_dates
tools.description: Lists up to 50 items due in the next 60 days across all current courses, soonest first, with the course name and due date.

tools.name: get_overdue
tools.description: Lists past due items from the last 45 days that still need action, with the course name and the date each was due.

tools.name: get_assignments
tools.description: Lists up to 25 assignments for one course with due dates and submission status: not submitted, draft, submitted or graded.

tools.name: get_my_grades
tools.description: Shows the posted overall grade for every current course, or "no grade posted yet".

tools.name: get_course_grade_items
tools.description: Lists every graded item for one course with the mark and percentage, including the course total when there is one.

tools.name: get_course_content
tools.description: Lists the sections of one course, such as weeks or topics, with up to 40 activities in each, such as pages, quizzes and forums.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Downloads one course file resource, such as a PDF, slide deck or handout, from its file_url and returns its readable text.

parameters.name: file_url
parameters.description: URL of the course file to download. Use the link from get_course_content.

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Lists the latest news forum posts with subject and text, up to 5 posts from each of up to 10 news forums.

parameters.name: course_ids
parameters.description: Course IDs from get_my_courses to limit the search. Leave out to cover all current courses.
